top_signals.title: Bessent calls meeting with China Vice Premier He Lifeng 'successful' ahead of Trump-Xi summit
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said his meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng was "successful" ahead of the Sept. 24 Trump-Xi summit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
